summary: Tested Text Wrapping (contorno de texto) feature for images in the Rich Text Editor. All 4 positioning options working correctly: Em linha, Centralizada, Flutuar Esquerda, Flutuar Direita.
passed_tests: ✅ Image button (data-testid='rtf-image-btn') opens popover in RTF toolbar
✅ Popover shows 4 positioning options with correct labels
✅ 'Flutuar Esquerda' button (data-testid='rtf-image-float-left-btn') - VISIBLE with cyan highlight
✅ 'Flutuar Direita' button (data-testid='rtf-image-float-right-btn') - VISIBLE with cyan highlight
✅ Buttons are disabled when URL input is empty
✅ Buttons are enabled when URL is entered
✅ 'Em linha' inserts image with class 'rtf-image-inline' and display: block
✅ 'Centralizada' inserts image inside div with text-align: center
✅ 'Flutuar Esquerda' inserts image with class 'rtf-image-float-left' and CSS float: left
✅ 'Flutuar Direita' inserts image with class 'rtf-image-float-right' and CSS float: right
✅ Float Left CSS verified: float: left, clear: left, max-width: 45%, margin-right: 16px, margin-bottom: 12px
✅ Float Right CSS verified: float: right, margin-left: 16px
✅ Text flows correctly around Float Left images (text wraps on right side)
✅ Text flows correctly around Float Right images (text wraps on left side)
✅ Popover includes descriptive text explaining each positioning option

feature_verification.access_path: Dashboard -> Click project 'Curso demo' -> Click 'Texto com IA' button (data-testid='add-rich-text-btn') -> Click image icon (data-testid='rtf-image-btn')

centralizada.label: Centralizada
centralizada.css_applied: text-align: center (parent div); display: inline-block; max-width: 80%;

flutuar_esquerda.label: Flutuar Esquerda
flutuar_esquerda.css_applied: float: left; clear: left; max-width: 45%; margin: 0 16px 12px 0;

flutuar_direita.label: Flutuar Direita
flutuar_direita.css_applied: float: right; clear: right; max-width: 45%; margin: 0 0 12px 16px;

critical_code_review_comments: Implementation is clean and follows CSS best practices for float-based text wrapping
Visual button icons clearly represent the positioning behavior
Float buttons are highlighted in cyan to indicate text wrapping capability

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All positioning options and text wrapping verified
